Yes. Semaglutide and tirzepatide are both registered with BPOM, Indonesia’s food and drug authority, and both are prescription-only medicines.

Semaglutide is registered as Ozempic, for type 2 diabetes, and as Wegovy, for weight management. Tirzepatide is registered as Mounjaro. BPOM approved it for type 2 diabetes in February 2026 and added weight management in July 2026.

In practice, “available” means available through a doctor’s prescription and a licensed pharmacy or health service. Neither drug is sold over the counter.

The two drugs in brief

Both drugs copy gut hormones that raise insulin when blood sugar is high and help you feel full.

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist made by Novo Nordisk, taken as a once-weekly injection. We explain the mechanism step by step in our guide to how semaglutide works.

Tirzepatide is a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist made by Eli Lilly, also a once-weekly injection. We cover its dual action in our guide to how tirzepatide works.

In Indonesian, both names keep their English spelling: semaglutide and tirzepatide.

Which brands BPOM has registered

Three brands of these two drugs are registered in Indonesia: Ozempic, Wegovy and Mounjaro.

Brand Active ingredient Approved use in Indonesia BPOM registration
Mounjaro Tirzepatide Type 2 diabetes (February 2026); weight management (July 2026) Approved by BPOM; launched in Jakarta on 4 July 2026 by PT Anugerah Pharmindo Lestari
Wegovy Semaglutide Weight management in adults with a BMI of 30 or more, or 27 or more with a weight-related condition DKI2464605443A1 and DKI2464605443B1, valid to 18 June 2029; registrant PT Beta Pharmacon
Ozempic Semaglutide Type 2 diabetes DKI2164605043A1, valid to 3 September 2030; registrant PT Beta Pharmacon

Two brands sold abroad are missing from the list. Rybelsus, the semaglutide tablet, and Zepbound, the US weight-management brand of tirzepatide, have no BPOM registration that we could find. In Indonesia, Mounjaro carries both the diabetes and the weight-management use.

BPOM’s July 2026 announcement also lists liraglutide as an approved GLP-1 receptor agonist with similar uses. It is an older, daily injection and outside the scope of this article.

One point on Ozempic: it is registered for type 2 diabetes, not for weight loss. Wegovy and Mounjaro are the brands registered for weight management.

When each brand reached Indonesia

The three registrations arrived over about five years, and tirzepatide is the newest.

Date Brand What happened
July 2026 Mounjaro Weight management added; launched in Jakarta on 4 July 2026
February 2026 Mounjaro Approved by BPOM for type 2 diabetes
June 2024 Wegovy Registered for weight management; BPOM’s public assessment report is dated 18 June 2024
2021 Ozempic First registered for type 2 diabetes; the “21” in DKI21 marks the year

The timing matters for anyone reading older articles. Advice written before February 2026 may say tirzepatide is not available in Indonesia. That is no longer true.

Prescription only: how people get them

Ozempic and Wegovy are registered as obat keras, the class of medicines that need a doctor’s prescription. You can see this in their registration numbers: both start with DKI, and the K marks a prescription drug. Mounjaro is also a prescription medicine.

The legal route has three steps:

  1. See a doctor. The doctor checks whether the drug suits you, based on your blood sugar, weight, other conditions and other medicines.
  2. Fill the prescription at a pharmacy, hospital or official health service.
  3. Buying online? Use only a platform certified as a Penyelenggara Sistem Elektronik Farmasi (PSEF). You can check a platform at psef.kemkes.go.id.

Cost is paid out of pocket for weight management. In December 2025, the Ministry of Health said GLP-1 therapy for obesity would need a Health Technology Assessment before BPJS Kesehatan could cover it, and that it was reviewing the national obesity treatment guideline. Prices vary by dose, pharmacy and region.

Semaglutide and tirzepatide in Bali

Bali follows the same national rules as Jakarta. The registered brands reach Bali through the same channels: a doctor’s prescription, then a hospital, clinic or licensed pharmacy.

If you live in Bali, start with a doctor who can review your health history and blood tests. Ask which brand fits your goal: Ozempic or Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes, Wegovy or Mounjaro for weight management. The pharmacy should dispense a pack that shows its BPOM number.

If you are visiting and already on treatment, Indonesia allows prescription medicine for personal use, within limits. A summary of Indonesian customs and BPOM rules by Can I Bring To (updated 20 October 2026) lists the main conditions:

  • up to the prescribed quantity for 90 days
  • a prescription or doctor’s letter in an easily understood language, signed by your doctor
  • medicine kept in its original packaging
  • the medicine declared to customs on arrival

Can I Bring To also notes that a doctor’s letter alone does not guarantee entry, so check with the Indonesian embassy before you travel. Injectable pens are usually kept cold before first use; follow the storage instructions on your own label for the journey.

If you are curious about cost, you can also check our tirzepatide prices in Bali. Our tirzepatide is supplied for research use only. It is not Mounjaro or Zepbound, and it is not a BPOM-registered medicine.

How to check a BPOM number

Every registered medicine carries a 15-character registration number (Nomor Izin Edar, NIE) on the pack. You can read part of it by eye and confirm the rest online.

  1. Find the number on the box. The main pack text must also be in Indonesian; a pack printed only in a foreign language is a warning sign.
  2. Read the first three letters. The first letter shows a brand name (D) or a generic (G). The second shows the class, including K for prescription medicines. The third shows whether the drug is made locally (L) or imported (I).
  3. Read the next two digits. They give the year the registration was first issued. Ozempic’s DKI21 points to 2021 and Wegovy’s DKI24 to 2024.
  4. Search it on BPOM’s checker. Enter the number or product name at cekbpom.pom.go.id under the Obat (medicines) category, or use the BPOM Mobile app. The result should match the product name, active ingredient and pack on your box.
  5. Still unsure? Call BPOM’s contact centre on 1500533.

The class letter marks over-the-counter, limited over-the-counter or prescription-only status (Emerhub), and the digits after the letters encode the registration year and sequence (ProductList).

Products without a BPOM number

A pen or vial without a BPOM registration number is not a registered medicine in Indonesia, whatever its label says. BPOM’s own guidance is blunt: illegal products do not carry an NIE issued by BPOM.

Without that number, nobody has checked the product’s content, strength, sterility or storage on BPOM’s behalf. After an online enforcement operation in June 2023, BPOM also warned that prescription-class drugs taken without a prescription or at the wrong dose can cause serious harm.

If you want semaglutide or tirzepatide as a treatment, the registered brands above, prescribed by a doctor, are the route that BPOM oversees.

Conclusion

Semaglutide and tirzepatide are both available in Indonesia, but only as prescription medicines. Ozempic is registered for type 2 diabetes and Wegovy for weight management. Mounjaro has covered both uses since July 2026. Rybelsus and Zepbound are not registered here.

If you are considering either drug, the route is the same in Jakarta and in Bali. See a doctor, fill the prescription at a licensed pharmacy, and check the BPOM number on the pack. If you are travelling with your own pens, bring your prescription and declare them on arrival.

Registrations change as BPOM approves new brands and uses, so check cekbpom.pom.go.id for the latest status before you buy.

Frequently asked questions

Is Mounjaro available in Indonesia?

Yes. BPOM approved Mounjaro (tirzepatide) for type 2 diabetes in February 2026 and for weight management in July 2026. It was launched in Jakarta on 4 July 2026 and needs a prescription.

Is Wegovy available in Indonesia?

Yes. Wegovy (semaglutide) received BPOM approval in June 2024 for long-term weight management in adults. It is sold through pharmacies and official health services with a doctor’s prescription.

Is Ozempic approved for weight loss in Indonesia?

No. Ozempic is registered for type 2 diabetes. For weight management, the registered semaglutide brand is Wegovy.

Can I buy semaglutide or tirzepatide without a prescription in Indonesia?

No. Both are prescription medicines. Pharmacies and licensed online platforms should ask for a doctor’s prescription.

Is Rybelsus available in Indonesia?

Not yet. Semaglutide tablets have not been distributed in Indonesia, so Rybelsus is not on the local market.

Does BPJS Kesehatan cover Wegovy or Mounjaro for weight loss?

Not as of December 2025. The Ministry of Health said GLP-1 therapy for obesity first needs a Health Technology Assessment before BPJS coverage can be considered.

Are semaglutide and tirzepatide available in Bali?

The same national rules apply in Bali as in Jakarta. The registered brands are available through doctors, hospitals and licensed pharmacies, with a prescription.

Can I bring Ozempic or Mounjaro into Bali from overseas?

Usually yes, for personal use and within limits. Carry a prescription or doctor’s letter, keep the pens in their original packaging, and declare them to customs. Check with the Indonesian embassy before you travel.

What does obat keras mean?

Obat keras is Indonesia’s class of prescription-only medicines. It is marked by the letter K in the registration number. Ozempic and Wegovy are both registered in this class.
